admin_auth_and_org_resolution.statement: Unauthenticated /admin visitors fail closed behind PKCE sign-in with zero admin API calls, and authenticated <org> locators resolve strictly via Propodus to immutable cloud_org_id UUIDs while denying unaffiliated, non-admin, and ambiguous orgs.
admin_auth_and_org_resolution.falsifier: Any unauthenticated or unauthorized org loads workspace state or dispatches org-scoped API calls in tests/admin_test.ts.

admin_route_xss_rejection.statement: Admin route parsing and URL sanitization accept valid /admin/<org> and /admin/?org=<org> locators while rejecting XSS, traversal, multi-segment, conflicting, and external return URLs and scrubbing URL tokens prior to API calls.
admin_route_xss_rejection.falsifier: tests/admin_test.ts fails on hostile slug, traversal, return_to, or fragment token checks.

admin_zero_seat_and_multi_org_isolation.statement: Zero-seat org admins administer org settings, delegation, limits, spend caps, devices, recovery contacts, policy templates, and billing portals without accessing repo task/event/evidence endpoints; org switching wipes prior DOM state and discards stale async responses.
admin_zero_seat_and_multi_org_isolation.falsifier: Admin calls repo query/batch APIs or leaks OrgA state into OrgB in tests/admin_test.ts.

static_site_and_confidentiality.statement: Existing public routes and scripts/check-site.ts pass unchanged, all classic browser scripts compile, and public-repo confidentiality checks pass across all authored files and Living Specs.
static_site_and_confidentiality.falsifier: scripts/check-site.ts or confidentiality scan in tests/admin_test.ts or tests/pricing_signup_test.ts fails.
